etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English ymaginable, from Latin imāginābilis; equivalent to imagine +‎ -able.

quote.citation: 2002, Peter Novobatzky, Ammon Shea, Depraved and Insulting English:
quote.text: While running, they were exposed to the most hideous bespawling imaginable.

quote.citation: 2015, Ashok Som, Christian Blanckaert, The Road To Luxury:
quote.text: By the early 1980s, Gucci was overlicensed, with its logo on every product imaginable from headscarves to key rings to lighters.
